description: Documentation for processed datasets in the CL Analyst ML pipeline

set_01.name: Cyclical Time Feature Set
set_01.summary: AlphaFactory features with cyclical time (Time_Sin, Time_Cos).

set_02.name: Raw Time Feature Set
set_02.summary: AlphaFactory features with raw time (Hour, Minute).

set_03.name: Master Squeeze Targets
set_03.summary: Master Squeeze Dataset containing both Strict (8%) and Relaxed (4%) targets, with pre-split Binary Long/Short columns for specialist training.

set_05.name: Triple Barrier Targets
set_05.summary: Dynamic Triple Barrier targets with ATR-based barriers (2x1 12H, 2x1 24H, 3x1 24H).

set_07.name: Extended Feature Set
set_07.summary: set_05 targets with extended features: 1-day (288) bar window, expanded macro windows (1D/3D/1W/2W/1M/3M), return distribution (DIST_*), stochastic oscillator (MOM_STOCH_*), Chaikin Money Flow (VOLFLOW_CMF_*), cross-timeframe ratios (CROSS_*), and day-of-week encoding (Time_DayOfWeek_Sin/Cos).

set_08.name: Exhaustion Feature Set
set_08.summary: set_07 features plus exhaustion cluster: cumulative return (EXHAUST_CUM_RET_*), ATR-normalised exhaustion (EXHAUST_CUM_ATR_*), and distance from recent high in ATR units (EXHAUST_DIST_HIGH_*). These help the model detect overextended moves where snap-back is likely.

set_09.name: MACRO Lookahead Fix
set_09.summary: Identical to set_08 but with fixed MACRO features: replaced resample('1h') lookahead with causally-safe bar-level rolling windows. MACRO_POS_* and MACRO_WIDTH_* are now computed directly on 5-min bars using rolling(hours × 12). No hourly resample, no forward-fill, no lookahead bias.
set_09.change_from_set_08: MACRO feature computation only — all other features identical

set_10.name: Causally Safe Dataset
set_10.summary: Identical features to set_09 (fixed MACRO rolling) but with causally-safe cleanup: bfill() removed (was a lookahead bias), warmup increased from 10,500 to 26,000 rows to cover MACRO_3M (25,920 bars) and VOL_VOLVOL_10080 (20,160 bars). Forward-fill only.
set_10.change_from_set_09: Cleanup method only — bfill removed, warmup 10500→26000

HourSet_01.name: 1-Hour Macro Swing-Trading Dataset
HourSet_01.summary: 5-min bars resampled to 1H. Swing-trading targets at 72H and 120H horizons with 1.5x, 2.0x, 2.5x ATR multipliers. AlphaFactory runs with bars_per_hour=1. Feature windows: 24H, 72H, 168H, 336H, 840H. Macro windows: 1W, 2W, 1M, 3M, 6M.

set_11.name: Extended Clean Dataset (Latest 5-min)
set_11.summary: Extension of set_10 (causally safe) with new features. 199 features total. No leakage. Canary result: long_logloss 319 trades, PF 0.84 (unprofitable). Marginal improvement over set_10 (0 trades) but still no profitable signals.
set_11.change_from_set_10: Additional features (199 vs 156). Same cleanup and MACRO methods.

HourSet_02.name: Extended 1-Hour Dataset (Latest Hourly)
HourSet_02.summary: Extension of HourSet_01 with new features. 199 features, ~101K rows. Uses 120H triple-barrier targets with 2.0x ATR. Canary result: short_f0.5 38 trades, PF 0.74 (unprofitable). No profitable signals found.

set_12.name: Exhaustion Divergence Dataset (Cumulative)
set_12.summary: Cumulative dataset: all set_11 features + Spread-Adjusted Momentum + new Exhaustion Divergence cluster (Slope Divergence, Temporal Peak Offset, Effort-Reward Ratio). ~215 features. LightGBM will auto-select the most informative features from the full collection.
set_12.change_from_set_11: Added EXHDIV_SLOPE_DIVERGE_*, EXHDIV_PEAK_OFFSET_*, EXHDIV_EFFORT_REWARD_* at each window
